hey.speaker: nii
hey.text: Ei! You're the new A-214? Chale, finally! I'm Nii — your roommate. Level 200, Computer Science.

choices.text: Nice to meet you, Nii. I'm {name}.
Is the room at least clean?

water.speaker: nii
water.text: You'll like it here, {name}. Tip number one: the water comes at five a.m. Set an alarm. Serious.

clean.speaker: nii
clean.text: Clean? Define clean. …It's clean-ish. I did my best, chale.

colleague.speaker: nii
colleague.text: Ah, a colleague! I'll show you where the good past questions are. Ehn — I mean the library. The library.

chat.speaker: nii
chat.text: Let me add you to the Block A group chat. Everything happens there — water times, parties, who's selling what.

tile.speaker: nii
tile.text: Room's upstairs, through the gateway. Old room, old floor — one of the tiles by your bed is loose, so mind your feet.
